description: This file defines the LogNode interface, which specifies a contract for various logging components in an Android project. It includes a method for outputting log messages with different priorities, tags, optional exceptions, and supports chaining multiple log nodes.

classes.name: LogNode
classes.description: An interface representing a logging node capable of outputting log messages and possibly forwarding them to another node for further processing.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Outputs a log message with specified priority, tag, message, and optional Throwable to the log destination.
